image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a lionfish (Pterois) resting on a sandy and rocky seabed. The fish displays characteristic red, white, and brown vertical stripes. Its dorsal spines are elongated and fanned out, though some appear to merge with the background or each other. The pectoral fins are large and fan-like, extending laterally. The head is visible with a prominent eye. The lighting creates strong shadows beneath the fins.

Several dorsal spines in the upper middle section appear to merge slightly with the background rock textures. The edges are not perfectly sharp, suggesting minor foreground-background bleeding or fusion.
There is significant motion blur or depth-of-field blur in the tail and rear fins. While this could be photographic, in AI images it often masks structural incompleteness. It is minor but noted.
